scope: Kun Online marketing editorial covers only

creativeRules.copy: The hook, never the full SEO title, is the dominant on-image headline. 3-8 short words, exact approved spelling and clear Arabic RTL. A one-line small benefit (subline) is optional. No process notes, no fabricated analytics, no other marketing claims.
creativeRules.visual: Illustrate the specific core idea with a bold tangible editorial metaphor (products, carts, packages, receipts, phones, inventory, funnel). Strong focal point, professional lighting and palette; distinctive composition for every article. No human figures/faces or real customer screenshots.
creativeRules.brand: Kun Online identity, strong clear typographic Arabic, generous safe margins; a small logo/wordmark can remain subtle. Avoid template grid, multiple generic charts, and unreadable tiny text.
creativeRules.technical: Keep canonical article URLs, original slugs, existing image URLs, title and alt metadata truthful. Render correct Arabic in PNG/WebP with RAQM and inspect actual output; verify 1200x630, thumbnails and no box glyphs. Do not publish if output differs from copy.
